reviews.author: geoc
reviews.text: Since I didn't make a reservation in advance, I had to wait, and after receiving a call from the owner around 8 o'clock, I went up the hill to Wausan Mountain for the first time in a long time. Miro Restaurant is delicious, but transportation to and from it is always difficult. I can't take a car, catch the local bus on time, or take a taxi for short distances. I have no choice but to walk, but it's located on a very steep slope, so I don't want to go even if it's hot, I don't want to go even if it rains, and I don't want to go even if it's cold. However, when you overcome the ambiguity and annoyance and go to the store, you order three or four snacks and eat them all. The best is ‘seasoned grilled pork neck’. You can think of it as pork ribs made from neck meat, but there is no fat at all, so it has a very soft and chewy texture. The seasoning is a delicious pork rib seasoning. Personally, I think Bongpiyang pork ribs are a backwards compatible version, but it's just a case of there being no rivals nearby. On this day, I ordered salt-and-seasoned grilled food because it was a new addition to the menu. It tastes similar to seasoned grilled pork neck. The only difference is that the ingredient is beef. The braised beef ribs are delicious, the fried meat is delicious, and the pollack egg soup is also delicious. The pork belly is good and the fried chicken is good, but I can't eat them all, so I always order the seasoned grilled pork neck and take turns ordering a couple of the remaining menu items. Miro Restaurant is so famous that tteokbokki is served as a meal kit, but it is not on the menu, and the owner serves it at the right time. I don't like meal kits because they taste like oden, but the original Miro Restaurant Tteokbokki has nothing like that. Tteokbokki Odeng is the most delicious. I am amazed every time I eat the braised tofu and radish that comes as a basic side dish. This is a perfect restaurant except that you have to climb a hill.

reviews.author: Deus ex machina
reviews.text:
A new standard for Korean beef omakase

As the name suggests, Abdo, a Korean beef omakase restaurant, boasts overwhelming quality and taste.

It offers visitors the highest quality Korean beef in a variety of ways and is known by word of mouth as a place where visitors can truly experience the true value of Korean beef.

Abdo captures the hearts of gourmets with the quality of its meat and the skill of its chefs, providing a special experience beyond simply eating the food.

First of all, the atmosphere of Abdo is luxurious yet cozy. The interior adopts a modern minimalist style to allow people to focus on the food itself, and lighting and space composition have been carefully designed.

Most of the seats are arranged in a bar style where you can communicate directly with the chef, allowing you to enjoy the cooking process right in front of your eyes.

Overall, the course is structured so that you can experience the various parts of Korean beef as diversely as possible. In particular, it is impressive that you can expand your understanding of Korean beef recipes by watching the chef's sincere explanations and cooking process.

Because the chef grilled it at the optimal temperature, I was able to feel the natural juiciness and soft texture of Korean beef. Additionally, the sauces and side dishes served with each course do not simply serve a supporting role, but also play a role in maximizing the taste of the main dish.

The service is also close to perfect. The staff provides comfort to visitors with friendly yet not excessive service, and the chef communicates naturally with guests with his passion for cooking.

Abdo is not just a place to eat, but a special space where you can experience the essence of high-quality Korean beef. It's the perfect choice for celebrating a special occasion or spending time with your loved ones.

Despite the high price, it is a recommended place because it provides more value and experience.

This is a restaurant with a great menu for office workers to have for lunch. There are a lot of customers starting a little early (11:30), but after about an hour, you can enter right away without waiting. They use good quality rice so the rice is glossy and tasty 👍
Since the quantity is large, there is a high chance that people who post the news will leave a message haha.

reviews.author: DONGJIN LEE
reviews.text:
A restaurant that spoils fresh and delicious raw fish with heartless salesmanship!

It's natural to order raw fish for the number of people, but when we finished eating and was served spicy fish stew, they said they had to add one more person because there was one more person...

I said I would just eat the spicy fish stew and get up right away, but then I was told that those who are here now are not allowed to eat anything from the table...
My mouth was so dry that I couldn't even taste the spicy stew.

Anyone who came late to go to the second round together got embarrassed and left right away!

This was my first time visiting a raw fish restaurant nearby after moving.
I was very embarrassed.

It's natural to order per person, but shouldn't you change the message depending on the situation?

Just as delicious food~...
